steps.text: Talk to Talia, twice, in the camp just south-west of the Edgeville Monastery.
Talk to Gertrude in her house west of Varrock, just south of the Cooks' Guild.
Interact with the stray dog just south of the western Varrock bank, barking at a guard.
Follow the stray dog to the house just west of the clothes shop.
Inspect the torn newspaper, chewed box, and rough bedding.
Follow the dog again until a cutscene triggers just north of the Cooks' Guild.
Interact with the dog again to ensure the dog is following you, then talk to Picklenose to the south-west of the guild.
You must not have a pet out while the dog is following you.
If you teleport away, the stray dog and her puppy will be waiting near Picklenose or at the den north of the Apothecary.
Use Grain (found north of Cooking Guild) on some fur with a needle and thread (or a costume needle) in your inventory to create a stuffed dog.
Pick up the stray puppy next to the stray dog.
Interact with the stray dog and follow them until another cutscene triggers by the gap in the wall north of the Cooks' Guild.
Kill both outlaws (level 22 and 23) and watch the next cutscene.
